# HexPiece 2.7.9

One fix from your look at the renders. Nothing here has been tested in game yet; the build's checks pass and it was rendered and
checked off-game.

- **Ama no Murakumo is a real sword now**, not a line of light: a pommel and a grip, a cross-guard, and a broad straight blade 1.9
  blocks long with a raised middle (white-hot down its ridge, pale gold across its flats, gold at its edges) and a sharp point, all of
  it light, in a soft gold glow that breathes. It is drawn in the right hand through the arm's own pose (and in first person).
